OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T005.atomic-claim-and-lease: The T015 production pilot proved no partial real-owner lease after conflict and exactly one run plus one owner-bound lease after success.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T005.eligibility-chain: Commit e61251c implements deterministic ready eligibility, dependency/queue/terminal checks and fail-closed task, PR, repository and resource conflict checks.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T005.gitless-transient-state: Claims, heartbeats, envelopes and release state remain in the external Bureau SQLite/state root; reviewed task definitions and closeout evidence remain in Git.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T005.ready-supply-visible: The v2 status projection exposes ready_supply and differentiates eligible unclaimed, claimed, blocked and no-eligible-work states.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T005.recovery-and-closeout: T016 closes root/compensation ambiguity, T015 proves terminalization and idempotent own-lease release, and the old orphaned run was reconciled through the typed release grip.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T005.worktree-and-pr-binding: The implementation binds task, plan, runtime, source head, workspace and working PR identity; conflicting or ambiguous states are covered by fail-closed tests.

OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T016.ambiguous-failure-retention: Unknown commit/readback outcomes retain owner-bound leases and require explicit recovery instead of claiming non-application.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T016.definite-failure-compensation: Pre-effect or definitively unapplied commits return structured non-success and compensate only acquisitions made by that attempt.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T016.identical-retry: Request, Registry root, intent and acquisition are journal-bound; the renewed production pilot converged an identical retry to the same assignment.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T016.recovery-root-binding: The private run journal binds the Registry root for commit readback, status and release; legacy journals use the canonical default.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T016.regression-evidence: 33 focused tests, Ruff, 3468 full tests, five GitHub checks, four review iterations, exact diff delivery and the successful renewed T015 pilot are bound.
OPERATOR-INTEGRATION-LOOP-V1-T016.single-registry-root: PR #460 normalizes one existing absolute Registry root and uses it for operator authorization, claim intent and claim commit.
